T: Put on a happy face. Pass the bowl.
D: A struggling party clown in 1981 Gotham slowly comes apart.
P: Serve the snacks when Arthur and his mum settle in front of the late-night talk show.
S: Popcorn coated in brown sugar and golden syrup caramel

Fresh popcorn coated in a glassy brown sugar and butter caramel with sea salt, baked crisp and poured into one big bowl for the couch. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Melt 100g butter with 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup and boil for 4 minutes. Take off the heat, stir in 1/2 tsp bicarb soda and 1 tsp sea salt, then pour over the popcorn and stir to coat. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break up.
Arthur's job as a party clown

Bite-sized balls of sharp cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion, rolled in smoked paprika and parsley, with crackers and red pepper jelly. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g finely grated vintage cheddar, 2 sliced spring onions and a pinch of cayenne. Chill for 1 hour until firm. Roll into 20 small balls. Roll half in 2 tbsp smoked paprika and half in finely chopped parsley. Chill until serving and set out with crackers and a small bowl of red pepper jelly.
Cucumber spears pickled in vinegar with dill and garlic
Cucumbers pickled overnight with dill, garlic, vinegar and salt, served in a jar with rye crackers.
M: Beef meatloaf with a brown sugar tomato glaze
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and peas.
Green room roast beef on rye
the talk show where Arthur is finally invited

Rare roast beef piled on rye with horseradish cream, pickles and crisp lettuce, cut in halves and stacked on a backstage platter. Season a 800g beef topside, sear all over and roast at 200C for 30 minutes for rare. Rest, cool and slice thinly. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Spread 8 slices of rye with the horseradish cream, then layer 4 with beef, sliced dill pickles and lettuce. Top with the other slices, cut in half and stack on a platter.
W: Green apples on sticks dipped in hard sugar syrup

Crisp green apples dipped in a glassy, blood red toffee that cracks when you bite it, set on sticks like a party table. Wash and dry 6 green apples well, remove the stalks and push in wooden sticks. Heat 400g caster sugar, 125ml water and 1 tbsp white vinegar over medium heat until dissolved, then boil without stirring until it reaches 150C on a thermometer. Add a few drops of red food colouring and swirl. Tilt the pan and dip each apple, twisting to coat, then stand on baking paper to set for 15 minutes.
K: Bourbon, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred ice cold

Bourbon stirred long with sweet vermouth and bitters until ice cold, strained into chilled glasses with a dark cherry and orange twist. Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer. Fill a jug with ice and add 240ml bourbon, 80ml sweet vermouth and 4 dashes of bitters. Stir steadily for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the chilled glasses, drop a cocktail cherry into each and twist a strip of orange peel over the top. For a booze-free version, mix cold black tea, cherry juice and a dash of orange.
